notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Overcast - Walden and the Werewolf, 10% off!
notes.content:
Overcast - Walden and the Werewolf is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

The game tells the story of an old hunter who lives alone in the woods. Walden, as it is called the hunter and the game's protagonist, began to be haunted by a mysterious creature that destroyed the village located near his cabin, killing every person residing on the premises. Now, Walden wants revenge.

Also, check out the Soundtrack.

*Offer ends April 25 at 10AM Pacific Time
